name: Takuma Co., Ltd.
summary: Takuma Co., Ltd. engages in the design, construction, and superintendence of various boilers, plant machineries, pollution prevention and environmental equipment plants, heating and cooling equipment, and feed water/drainage sanitation equipment and facilities in Japan. The company engages in the engineering, procurement, and construction of municipal solid waste and water treatment plants; and power retail business, as well as provides after sales services, including plant maintenance, operation management, and O&M.
